essence: The one-faced Śiva directly removes the sin of brahman-murder.
The three-faced fire form directly removes the sin of brahman-murder.
By wearing the five-faced form, one is released from all sins.
There is no doubt that one is released from sins beginning with brahman-murder.
Even touching the guru's wife with the back, belly, or hand is contemplated.
